words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) makes the three-word clause begin with certainty before either destination or return is named. Its governance reaches across the fronted predicate, so {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) receives focus while {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) remains the asserted noun under the particle. After the punitive action of 88:24, this emphatic nominal frame changes the register from narrated event to settled jurisdictional verdict: their return is not a possible sequel but certified news. The doubled sound of the particle gives that certainty audible weight, and the next ayah repeats the emphatic frame after {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) (88:26), making return and reckoning two confirmed stages.

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) is not a loose setting for the return; it is the fronted destination predicate. The preposition gives the movement an endpoint, and the attached first-person plural suffix makes that endpoint the speaking divine authority. Because the phrase comes before {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}), the reader meets the destination first and only then the return-event, so the return is heard as already confined to Us rather than open-ended. The shift from third-person {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) in 88:24 to {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) in 88:25 turns the named punishing agent into the immediate speaking destination. The same return-to-divine-endpoint pressure appears in the formula of 96:8, but this ayah makes it the possessed return of the warned group; 88:26 then changes the same speaker-frame from return to Us into account upon Us.

topics.headline: endpoint and authority fused in the destination phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that return is directed to a definite divine endpoint, not toward an unnamed place or vague future.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the prepositional phrase with first-person plural suffix as the destination complement associated with the return.

topics.headline: fronted endpoint governs how the return is heard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the endpoint before the return noun, so destination controls the clause before the event is named.
topics.reason: The local syntax forces {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) as the fronted predicate before the delayed noun {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}), supporting endpoint focus and restriction without adding fallback routing.

topics.headline: bound first-person suffix makes the endpoint immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is compressed into a bound first-person speaker-form and that the discourse moves from a named third-person agent to direct divine speech.
topics.reason: The suffix in {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) is a surface first-person plural pronoun, and the previous ayah names {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) as the agent (88:24).

topics.headline: lengthened endpoint before the compact return noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the endpoint lingering in recitation before the return noun closes the clause.
topics.reason: The sound rows track the final length of {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) as a local recitational effect before {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}).

topics.headline: return-to-divine-endpoint formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 88:25 participates in a wider return-to-divine-endpoint formula while selecting a more possessed return noun than 96:8.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah row gives a concrete formula parallel in 96:8; the local wording keeps the endpoint pressure but uses {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) for the warned group's possessed return.

topics.headline: same speaker-frame moves from destination to responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the next ayah keeps the divine speaker-frame while turning arrival into reckoning responsibility.
topics.reason: The bridge is local and concrete: 88:25 says return to Us, and 88:26 says account upon Us with the same first-person plural speaker-frame.

words.prose: {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) closes the clause by naming the return as a possessed event: the plural suffix is attached to the masdar, so the return clings to the warned group as their own liability. Because the noun arrives after {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and the fronted {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}), the event is already certified and routed to Us before the group is named in the suffix. The root pressure is not generic motion; it is coming back after departure, so after the turning away of 88:23 the word gives refusal a reversal: voluntary aversion cannot cancel compulsory return. That return-field pressure can stand near repentance language, but the local endpoint keeps the meaning as return-to-authority, not repentance. The local form keeps this as a return-event, not a place of return like {{ar:مَآب}} ({{tr:maʾāb}}) or a praised returner profile like {{ar:أَوَّاب}} ({{tr:awwāb}}), and variant or expansion evidence only highlights the noun and suffix pressure without replacing the compact canonical clause. Its singular abstract form gathers the plural group into one owned return, the adjacent i/yā-like sound links endpoint and event before the suffix closes them, and 88:26 then turns the same group's return into {{ar:حِسَابَهُم}} ({{tr:ḥisābahum}}), their account.

topics.headline: possessed masdar binds the group to return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the return is not an indefinite event; it is a defined liability attached to the group by the suffix.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix of {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) as the genitive possessor of the masdar, with referent choice depending on the prior human discourse group.

topics.headline: returning subject becomes reckoned patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group first owning the return-event in 88:25 and then facing account in 88:26.
topics.reason: The local construct makes the group possess or perform the return, while the forward row identifies the same suffix group in the account noun of 88:26.

topics.headline: return noun lands after certainty and endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the return noun is the closure point, arriving only after certainty and the divine endpoint have already framed it.
topics.reason: The grammar makes {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) the delayed governed noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) after the fronted predicate {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}).

topics.headline: coming back reverses prior turning away
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices return as reversal after departure and refusal, not as mere travel into an unspecified future.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the return field to the immediate prior turning-away scene (88:23), and no guardrail evidence contradicts the coming-back sense.

topics.headline: homeward return becomes answerable arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ordinary image of coming back is morally charged by refusal, punishment, and the divine endpoint.
topics.reason: The return-event is locally framed by {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}), preceded by refusal and punishment, and followed by accounting in 88:26.

topics.headline: related root forms stay as contrast, not replacements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word draws on the return field while choosing the event noun instead of a place-of-return noun or a praised repeated-returner title.
topics.reason: V4 has no guardrail rows for this root, so absence cannot reject the family pressure; local grammar narrows the payoff to the surface event noun {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}), not {{ar:مَآب}} ({{tr:maʾāb}}) or {{ar:أَوَّاب}} ({{tr:awwāb}}).

topics.headline: return-field overlap without repentance sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the strength of the return field while keeping the local meaning as return to authority rather than repentance.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute can sharpen the return-field pressure, but the local endpoint frame selects return-to-authority and does not call the group repentant.

topics.headline: event noun instead of verb, place, or repeated form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that return is objectified as a substantive fact inside the nominal clause rather than narrated as a timed action or named as a destination-place.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the local word as a gerund/masdar, and the surrounding clause is nominal rather than a finite return verb.

topics.headline: one return-event gathers the plural group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse widening from a singular punished refuser to a plural group gathered into one possessed return-event.
topics.reason: The suffix of {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) is plural, while the previous punishment verse individualizes with a singular object (88:24).

topics.headline: variant apparatus highlights compact canonical wording
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant and expansion evidence highlights the pressure points of the return noun and suffix without replacing the canonical three-word clause.
topics.reason: The variants are useful as contrast: they do not change the local destination syntax or require adding an explicit referent to the canonical suffix.

topics.headline: sharp return-noun onset and bound closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the return noun enters sharply after the lengthened endpoint and closes on the attached group suffix.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe the local surface of {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}), especially its hamza onset, long vowel movement, and suffixed closure.

topics.headline: endpoint and return are linked in adjacent sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sound continuity between the destination phrase and the return noun, reinforcing their syntactic bond.
topics.reason: The adjacent words {{ar:إِلَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) and {{ar:إِيَابَهُمْ}} ({{tr:iyābahum}}) are syntactically bound as predicate and delayed noun, and the sound rows observe their adjacent i/yā-like pressure.

topics.headline: arrival stage hands forward to account
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that return is the arrival stage that creates the forward need for reckoning in 88:26.
topics.reason: The next ayah (88:26) follows the return with account, keeping the same group and speaker-frame.

topics.headline: rare event noun concentrates the clause closure

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal إِيَابَهُمْ is governed by the fronted destination إِلَيْنَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return-place branch lets إياب name both movement back and the point at which dispersed persons gather. Fronting إِلَيْنَا makes the destination constitutive of the event: this is not motion in general but their convergence upon Us.

activation_trace.role: Return to a return-place supplies both the homeward motion and its terminal gathering function.

changed_reading.before: They will come back to Us.
changed_reading.after: Their return is a collective convergence whose very return-place is with Us.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural suffix in إِيَابَهُمْ is drawn through the singular deictic vector إِلَيْنَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The quarter-or-direction branch keeps the plurality spatially live: their arrivals may issue from many orientations, yet the fronted إِلَيْنَا collapses those quarters into one endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The image of a quarter from which one comes turns the plural return into convergence from multiple directions.

changed_reading.before: All of them share a destination.
changed_reading.after: However divergent their quarters and orientations, every line of arrival closes upon Us.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The event noun إِيَاب can retain an internal texture of recurrent travel rather than only its endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of limbs repeatedly returning in travel expands إياب into accumulated back-and-forth exertion. The final return gathers a history of repeated bodily motions, not merely a single last reversal.

activation_trace.role: Rhythmic return of limbs in travel gives the return an iterative, embodied interior.

changed_reading.before: Their return is one terminal transition.
changed_reading.after: Their return gathers the repeated motions and exertions by which their whole course was traveled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening supplies an arrival toward the addressee and, through the non-dominant mapped branch of غ ش و, an approach that reaches its target. Against those incoming vectors, إيابهم becomes the answering vector: the event comes upon its hearers, and the persons implicated in it return to Us.

activation_trace.role: Return to a gathering point supplies the humanward vector that answers the opening arrival.
Coming and arrival establish the first directed motion, toward the addressee.
The non-dominant coming-or-visitation image makes the covering event an arrival that reaches those addressed.

structural_cues: The opening question directs an event toward كَ, while the focus fronts إِلَيْنَا before the returning plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coming, visitation, and return-place images; I infer that the opening arrival anticipates an answering human return. A live alternative is that the opening motion only frames the report and does not mirror إياب.

changed_reading.before: The line states a one-way return to a destination.
changed_reading.after: The line completes a reciprocal directional frame: what comes upon the hearer announces the return of its human subjects to Us.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two sets of faces occupy opposed conditions, while one set is explicitly satisfied with its striving. Their shared return therefore does not flatten them into an undifferentiated mass; convergence becomes a facing encounter in which distinct histories become manifest.

activation_trace.role: The gathering-point image supplies the common endpoint shared by the contrasted faces.
Facing and confrontation turn arrival at the endpoint into an encounter rather than mere relocation.
Lowering and submission supply one visibly manifested condition at the encounter.
Good condition and favor supply the opposed manifested condition without changing the common endpoint.
Purposeful movement toward an objective gives the differentiated face a prior trajectory.
Acceptance rather than displeasure marks one trajectory as affirmatively recognized at return.

structural_cues: The repeated وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ construction holds the day constant while reversing the faces' predicates.
The plural possessive هُمْ in the focus can gather both contrasted groups without erasing their difference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasted faces, purposeful striving, acceptance, and one gathering point; I infer that return is where trajectories become legible on the face. The alternative is that the facial states are consequences described independently of the mechanics of return.

changed_reading.before: Their return is a uniform collective movement.
changed_reading.after: Their common return is a shared confrontation that preserves and exposes sharply different lived trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same context root spans exhausted human labor and a mountain set upright. Coupled with the focus branches of traveled recurrence and return-place, this creates a motion-to-fixity model: spent movement ends in a definitive emplacement.

activation_trace.role: Repeated bodily movement supplies the mobile, effort-bearing side of the transition.
The return-place supplies the fixed terminus at which motion is gathered.
Weariness and affliction make the prior motion costly and depleting.
Setting something upright and conspicuous supplies the contrasting image of final fixed placement.

structural_cues: ن ص ب recurs first as a human predicate and later as a passive construction applied to mountains.
The focus falls after the sequence of laboring bodies and inspected, fixed creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustion, erection, iterative travel, and a return-place; I supply the arrow from depleted motion to definitive emplacement. The live alternative is that the two ن ص ب occurrences are only a lexical echo with no bearing on إياب.

changed_reading.after: Return converts exhausted, repeated motion into a final placement as settled and conspicuous as something erected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The favorable scene is not empty space: concealment by growth, resting places, objects put in position, aligned cushions, and spread furnishings make a prepared spatial order. For this coexisting trajectory, the return-place branch becomes reception into an already arranged habitation.

activation_trace.role: Return-place and gathering point provide the destination that the material sequence renders habitable.
A garden screened by growth supplies a bounded, inhabited destination rather than an abstract elsewhere.
A place of settled rest turns arrival into repose and emplacement.
Putting an object in its appointed place supplies deliberate preparation before the returners arrive.
Alignment on an even line gives the destination visible order.
Dispersal across the space fills out the prepared field into which gathering can occur.

structural_cues: Repeated فِيهَا and passive or resultative descriptions present a destination whose arrangement precedes its occupants.
The sequence alternates elevation, placement, alignment, and spreading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a return-place plus materially arranged rest; I infer reception into prepared order. A live alternative is that these furnishings describe reward but do not modify the semantics of return, and this model should not be generalized to every referent of هُمْ.

changed_reading.before: The return reaches an unspecified endpoint.
changed_reading.after: For the favorable trajectory, return is reception into a destination already positioned, aligned, spread, and made fit for repose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fourfold direction of attention toward camel, sky, mountains, and earth rehearses movement along visible quarters. Creation, raising, erection, and surfacing make those quarters legible as made order; the fronted إِلَيْنَا then reads as the culminating direction beyond the inspected field.

activation_trace.role: The quarter from which one comes lets the inspected directions become multiple departure lines for one final return.
Directing sight or insight supplies the repeated act of orientation.
Bringing creation into being makes the first inspected object evidence of originated order.
Raising supplies the upward axis of the inspected field.
Erecting something visibly supplies a fixed vertical marker within that field.
An extended level surface supplies the horizontal axis and closes the directional survey.

structural_cues: إِلَى recurs before each inspected object and returns in intensified pronominal form as إِلَيْنَا in the focus.
The branchless root ك ي ف occurs only as a structural interrogative at 88:17 word 5, 88:18 word 3, 88:19 word 3, and 88:20 word 3; no mapped root or branch is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed looking and four modes of made spatial order; I infer that the repeated إِلَى trains a deictic turn that culminates in إِلَيْنَا. The alternative is that the inspection sequence is evidentiary but does not alter the later return clause.

changed_reading.before: إِلَيْنَا is only the locator of a future return.
changed_reading.after: إِلَيْنَا completes a practiced redirection: every inspected quarter becomes a line of orientation whose ultimate closure is toward Us.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembering and reminder belong to the messenger's task, while controlling surveillance is explicitly negated. The fronted إِلَيْنَا consequently marks exclusive custody: speech can recall and direct, but it does not own, force, or administer the return.

activation_trace.role: The return-place with Us supplies the jurisdiction withheld from the human reminder.
Restoring something to awareness defines the messenger's limited, non-coercive operation.
Present-state negation sharply excludes the attributed role of control.
The image of a dominating overseer names precisely the custody denied to the messenger.

structural_cues: إِنَّمَا limits the messenger to reminder, لَسْتَ negates control, and إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا reallocates the return.
عَلَيْهِم in the negated control clause contrasts with the first-person destination إِلَيْنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, explicit negation, controlling oversight, and return to a gathering point; I infer a division of jurisdiction between prompting awareness and owning the return. The alternative is a looser rhetorical contrast without an administrative distinction.

changed_reading.before: To Us simply identifies where they go.
changed_reading.after: To Us assigns exclusive custody of their return, sharply separating divine ingathering from the messenger's non-coercive reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away gives the person a chosen outward vector, and covering truth makes that vector self-concealing. The return-place branch reverses both claims: aversion can determine present orientation but cannot establish another terminal quarter.

activation_trace.role: Return to the gathering point supplies the unavoidable terminal vector.
The quarter-of-coming image denies turning-away the power to create an independent final direction.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the deliberate vector that the focus overturns.
Concealing truth makes the away-turn an attempted withdrawal from recognition as well as direction.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding coordinated verbs تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ are followed by the emphatic destination clause إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا.
The plural هُمْ in the focus retains those who turned away within the scope of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aversion, concealment, and return from a quarter to a gathering point; I infer that the final vector reverses the chosen local vector. The alternative is only temporal succession, with no spatial reversal activated inside إياب.

changed_reading.before: Their return may sound like a willing homecoming.
changed_reading.after: Even deliberate aversion and concealment remain bounded motions: turning away cannot furnish an alternate final direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between divine punishment and a subsequent account assigned upon Us. Counting and examining the matter distinguish حساب from إياب: return is the transfer into divine custody that makes review inescapable, not merely another word for review.

activation_trace.role: The gathering-point image makes return the intake or transfer around which the closing acts are arranged.
Pain and penalty supply the judicial consequence immediately before the custody clause.
The worshiped deity image identifies the acting authority rather than leaving the first-person plural indeterminate.
The weight of the paramount matter enlarges the consequence framing the return.
Counting and accounting supply the distinct operation that follows return.
Examining a matter turns account from raw arithmetic into responsible review.

structural_cues: The closing sequence places إِيَابَهُمْ between punishment in 88:24 and ثُمَّ ... حِسَابَهُم in 88:26.
Parallel possessive nouns and emphatic clauses distinguish إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ from عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies penalty, divine agency, return-place, counting, review, and the connective sequence; I infer a custody-to-review relation while not forcing every clause into a strict chronology. The alternative is emphatic restatement of one undivided end rather than procedural differentiation.

changed_reading.before: Return and reckoning are interchangeable names for the same end.
changed_reading.after: Return is the decisive transfer into divine custody; account is the distinct counting and review that lies upon Us thereafter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The solar-setting analogy is surprising because هُمْ denotes persons, not the sun. It remains anchored in the packet's explicit focus branch for the sun returning to its setting-place and is sharpened by the sky-earth visual frame. Downstream prose should present it as a temporal-spatial analogy for disappearance and assigned return, never as the lexical replacement of human إياب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِيَابَهُمْ is activated through the focus branch in which setting is itself return to a fixed place.

activation_trace.role: The sun's return to its setting-place supplies a cycle in which vanishing from sight is arrival, not annihilation.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper field across which a setting course can be imagined.
The lower realm opposed to the sky supplies the horizon-like terminal field for the analogy.

changed_reading.before: Disappearance from the present field looks like simple absence.
changed_reading.after: Like a setting that reaches its assigned place, their disappearance can be imaged as the closure of a course in return to Us.

It remains anchored by the focus branch of rhythmic bodily return and by explicit contextual motion. Downstream prose should call it a kinetic process image, not claim that watering, striving, flowing, and إياب are synonyms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recurrent-limb branch inside إِيَاب allows the plural return to be felt as an embodied procession assembled from repeated motions.

activation_trace.role: Rhythmic return of limbs in travel supplies the embodied cadence of the procession.
The working limb makes bodily action, rather than abstract biography, part of what is gathered.
The non-dominant image of successive following in one track supplies procession and sequence without replacing the source's watering sense.
Purposeful motion toward an objective gives the procession intention and accumulated striving.
Continuous flow keeps the return processive rather than reducing it to a punctual arrival.

changed_reading.before: Their return happens at one final instant.
changed_reading.after: Their return can be carried as a gathered procession of working limbs, purposeful courses, following tracks, and continuous flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reversal is surprising because both the encompassing event and disbelief activate covering images, which could just multiply concealment. It remains valid because the opening also activates manifestation and the focus gathers the self-concealing person into the event's reach. Downstream prose should qualify this as an abductive concealment-versus-manifestation model, not define إياب as disclosure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The gathering-point branch of إِيَابَهُمْ prevents the person who covers truth from remaining outside the event that comes upon all.

activation_trace.role: Return to a gathering point supplies the collision point between private concealment and comprehensive event.
An event that encompasses and covers all denies the concealer an exterior refuge.
Bringing a thing forth and making it manifest supplies the counter-motion to concealment.
Concealing truth supplies the person's attempted withdrawal from manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Covering truth can seem to keep the person outside recognition.
changed_reading.after: Their return is the point at which chosen concealment is gathered into an all-reaching event and can no longer secure an outside.

strongest_changes: A generic homecoming became an inescapable reversal of deliberate turning-away and concealment.
The fronted destination became exclusive custody, distinguished from the messenger's reminder and from the subsequent operation of account.
The repeated إِلَى ... كَيْفَ sequence made إِلَيْنَا the culmination of directed attention across created quarters.
The shared return preserved opposed faces and trajectories rather than flattening the plural into one condition.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root simultaneously supported terminal gathering, convergence from many quarters, iterative bodily travel, and solar setting. Context then redistributed those images across jurisdiction, reversal, prepared space, visible orientation, and accountable transfer without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The iterative-limb branch may be only a lexical halo around the event noun rather than an active description of this return.
The relation between return and account may be procedural without being a strict chronology for every clause in the closing sequence.
The prepared-habitation model clearly fits one favorable trajectory but should not be universalized across every referent of هُمْ.
The repeated ك ي ف cue is structurally strong but branchless and therefore supports no lexical citation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Return to the final gathering point.** Evidence: `ء و ب` B001 turning back to a return-place/gathering point. Structural cue: after divine punishment is named, the discourse shifts to first-person plural divine claim. Role: `إياب` gathers the trajectories of faces, effort, refusal, and signs back to their source. Abductive move: every movement shown earlier has a terminus. Reading change: the ayah reads as closure of motion, not merely future destination.

2. **Rhythmic return after creaturely travel.** Evidence: `ء و ب` B003 rhythmic return of limbs in travel/camel travel by day; earlier `ء ت ي` B009 camel foreleg return and `ء ب ل` B001 camels. Structural cue: camel and movement roots are activated before the final return. Role: `إياب` becomes embodied as repeated travel-motion, not only metaphysical return. Abductive move: the surah’s pastoral travel body supplies a model for return. Reading change: return reads as a gait-like inevitability: each stride comes back into account.

3. **Return from every direction faced.** Evidence: `ء و ب` B004 direction/quarter from which one comes; `و ج ه` B002 orientation, `و ل ي` B006/B007 turning toward/away. Structural cue: the surah repeatedly organizes faces and directions. Role: `إلينا` fixes the true direction after misorientation. Abductive move: all faced directions ultimately resolve into one return-direction. Reading change: the ayah corrects orientation: whatever one turned toward or away from, the return is “to Us.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The camel-travel branch made `إياب` less abstract and more kinetic. The earlier face/orientation language made the final `إلينا` feel like the correction of all misdirected looking and turning.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Return reverses the rejecter's attempted change of direction.** **Lexical:** `ء و ب` B001, "turning back to a return-place." **Cue:** `تَوَلَّىٰ` in 88:23 describes withdrawal, but emphatic `إِنَّ` and fronted `إِلَيْنَا` in 88:25 fix the endpoint before naming `إِيَابَهُمْ`. **Role:** turning away supplies outbound motion; return supplies reversal; fronting supplies the nonnegotiable destination. **Abduction:** I infer a direct reversal between the two roots across the intervening consequence. **Reading change:** `إيابهم` is not generic recurrence but the cancellation of directional escape.

2. **The repeated directional frame turns observers into the objects of direction.** **Lexical:** `ء و ب` B004, "direction or quarter from which one comes," alongside B001. **Cue:** 88:20 directs human sight `إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ`; 88:25 replaces that outward object with first-person `إِلَيْنَا` and makes the people themselves return. **Role:** B004 gathers the `إلى` phrases into a directional system; B001 reverses the vector from gaze going outward to persons coming back. **Abduction:** I infer deliberate syntactic echo from the shared preposition. **Reading change:** the surah's observational geometry folds back on the observer: one who directs attention through the world is also moving toward an endpoint.

3. **Return is the administrative handoff that makes account possible.** **Lexical:** `ء و ب` B001 includes gathering at a return-place. **Cue:** messenger-control is denied in 88:22, divine consequence is named in 88:24, and `ثُمَّ ... حِسَابَهُم` follows in 88:26. **Role:** gathering transfers dispersed persons into the jurisdiction where reckoning occurs. **Abduction:** I infer that return enables account; the packet gives order but does not describe a tribunal. **Reading change:** the ayah is procedural as well as spatial: return consolidates those whom no human reminder controls for the account claimed by God.

4. **Bodily travel itself is gathered into the image of return.** **Lexical:** `ء و ب` B003, "rhythmic return of limbs in travel." **Cue:** the window includes earth as extended surface in 88:20 and the bodily turn in 88:23 before naming final return. **Role:** B003 gives macro-direction a repeated bodily mechanism: every step advances through cycles of return within the limbs. **Abduction:** I infer that ordinary locomotion miniaturizes the final movement. **Reading change:** `إياب` can be felt not only as destination but as a return-pattern already embedded in travel itself.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:26 revealed the purpose of return as accountable gathering. It also corrected a purely spatial reading of `إيابهم`: reaching the destination is an administrative transition into reckoning, not the endpoint of the mechanism.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin ya da şeyin geldiği yere, yerleştiği yere veya varacağı dönüş noktasına geri dönmesi; bundan hareketle dönüşün kendisi, dönüş zamanı ya da dönüş yeri de anlatılır. Bazı kullanımlarda anlam, suyun veya öğütülen şeyin toplandığı belirli yerle sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel çekirdek, bir kişinin veya şeyin geri dönmesi ve önceki ya da beklenen varış yerine yönelmesidir.

Kuyu ortasında suyun toplandığı yer veya değirmende unun çıktığı yer gibi kullanımlar belirli yer adlarıdır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kökün dalları geri dönme çekirdeği etrafında örgütlenir: genel dönüş ve dönüş yeri, dini yöneliş, yürüyüşte geri salınım, her yönden gelme, kutsal övgünün yinelenmesi, geceleyin gelme ve güneşin batıya varıp batması. Anlamlar ortak dönüş hissinden beslenir, fakat çoğu dal belirli bağlam, zaman, söz öbeği veya katılımcıyla sınırlanır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref resolves against qac_morphemes for this ayah

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
